name: loops-run-terminal-output
alt: The Studio terminal after hdrctl run in a project whose thread.yaml repeats two workflows: pass 1 of 2, a loop line announcing a one second wait, then pass 2 of 2, and a project summary with 4 of 4 workflows OK.

name: loops-dry-run-execution-plan
